A 21-year-old right-handed cisgender female, two
months prior to presentation, noted stiffness and difficulty with
ambulation. One-month prior to admission, she experienced
recurrent depression with myriad vegetative and nonvegetative
symptoms of depression. On admission her chief complaint was I
am a tree, standing motionless and minimally responding to
query. After treatment with quetiapine, mirtazapine and
hydroxyzine for a one-week period, her perception of being a
tree fully resolved.
